title: Plan P2-004 intervention proposal contract
businessObjective: Define a finite, reviewable intervention proposal boundary that turns grounded intelligence into advice without granting models, proposals, or callers authorization or execution authority.
technicalObjective: Write the P2-004 V1 design and make its packet executable-ready: one closed proposal schema, a runtime-safe semantic validator with a small public surface, an exact deterministic validator command for separate admission, tests, documentation, evidence, and bounded dependencies; do not implement the contract.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: P2-004 remains static Tier-0 contract work only.
P2-002 intelligence results are grounded but remain non-authoritative inputs.
A separate governance task must admit the exact P2-004 validator before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: The design defines a single closed Draft 2020-12 proposal authority, exact finite fields/outcomes/reason codes/bounds, and a minimal runtime-safe semantic public interface that accepts no caller authority.

The design requires diagnosis, evidence references, confidence, recommended action, alternatives, affected systems, requested capabilities, risk classification, approval requirement, verification plan, rollback plan, expected outcome, and an explicit non-authority posture.

The design rejects self-approval, authorization, execution, verification, production eligibility, unknown capability, unsupported risk, invalid provenance, malformed input, and cross-field inconsistency fail closed without throwing.

The design preserves deep-module and hexagonal boundaries: no provider, transport, persistence, workflow, policy, approval, executor, audit-store, SDK, network, or environment import in core contract logic.
The P2-004 packet names exact allowed paths, task-specific verification evidence, real exact validator command, required checks, rollback, GOV-044/GOV-045 dependencies, and no production permissions.

A distinct GOV-045 is specified only to admit `node tests/intervention-proposals/validate-intervention-proposal-contract-v1.mjs` shell-free with fixed arguments; GOV-044 does not broaden command execution.
solEscalationTriggers: Any field or decision that implies policy, approval, authorization, execution, production, data retention, credentials, payments, bookings, inventory, pricing, RLS, persistence, workflow, or provider invocation is out of scope.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only GOV-044 design, P2-004/GOV-045 future packet preparation, task state, and GOV-044 evidence; preserve P2-002 and all terminal history, runtime code, canonical sources, and external systems.
